randomization_and_statistics: Order is prospectively fixed A/B/A/B/A/B/A so every candidate run is bracketed by stock on the same VM. Primary decision uses the three paired candidate deltas against the mean of their adjacent stock arms, reports individual and median effects, and a seeded 10000-resample paired percentile 95% interval. Raw per-request rows remain authoritative. The sequence is stopped early for a correctness/quality/SLO/resource failure, absolute watchdog, or budget condition, not for an inconvenient performance sign.
quality_gate: Every arm must pass exact deterministic semantic JSON, paired overall/category non-regression, and NLL <= 8.02778927385807. The absolute compact quality failure remains carried forward and prohibits a general quality claim.
slo: Every arm must complete 100% exact geometry with TTFT p95 <= 10000 ms, TPOT p95 <= 100 ms, zero prefix-cache query/hit delta, and no typed failures.
trace_gate: Profiler admission must report fixed_8k_128_c8, concurrency=8, requests=8, exact geometry, and nonempty trace. Postprocessing must find >=95% grouped-MLA stage-1 launches with grid batch dimension 8. Summed durations remain diagnostic and cannot be used as wall-time share.
promotion_rule: PROMOTE the split intervention only if all three B arms and their adjacent A controls pass, the median paired c8 throughput gain is >=5%, the 95% paired bootstrap interval lower bound is >0, no candidate c1 regression exceeds 2%, and quality/SLO gates pass. Otherwise STOP this split lineage. No provider or fully quality-adjusted cost claim is allowed.
artifact_contract: Retrieve, remote/local hash, and internally validate a distinct archive for every arm before overwriting remote output. Preserve all commands, source patch evidence, metrics, request rows, semantic/quality results, traces, telemetry, stdout/stderr, and manifests. Keep one independent 4500-second provider watchdog. After A4 or any terminal stop, delete instance and disk, verify instance GET not-found, and verify fresh zero instance/disk inventories. Reconcile total session exposure rather than summing overlapping provisional arm estimates.
stop_rules: Do not repeat an unchanged failed arm. Use the ten-minute in-place repair window only for a materially changed harness/infrastructure correction. Teardown immediately on unsafe state, budget/watchdog stop, or completed terminal lineage; otherwise continue the preregistered A/B sequence autonomously.
